task.problem: TASK-066 implemented A1 as a thin workflow_dispatch wakeup that calls one canonical `aios run`, but the current workflow has no durable request identity beyond one GitHub workflow delivery. GitHub reruns, repeated API delivery, or a Human/Brain submitting the same intended wakeup again can therefore reach the Operator as a new invocation. The Runtime correctly protects one concurrently active repository mutation with its process lock and canonical RUN machinery, but it does not know whether two separate outer events represent the same wakeup request. A host/process crash also destroys invocation-local context even though `.git/aios` RUN/RESULT/FAILURE state survives. A2 must add an idempotent outer identity and durable reconciliation record without turning the outer workflow into a scheduler, RUN authority, retry engine, or second execution path.
